scope.description: User-directed Canada-first deep research on eight large defence prime contractors, emphasizing broad portfolios, flagship programs, public delivery relationships, and review-ready evidence rather than single-product summaries.

source.title: Lockheed Martin Canada overview
source.locator: Canada overview, capabilities, locations and economic impact
source.summary: The official Canadian overview describes a wholly owned Canadian defence and technology business with more than 1,000 employees, seven sites, and work in software engineering, systems integration, manufacturing, training, and sustainment.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official Canadian profile, portfolio pages, current program evidence, and public customer or partner relationship evidence
followUpQuestions: Should the reviewer retain three portfolio-level capabilities or split any capability family into product-level records?
Are the flagship program and relationship represented at the right level without implying endorsement beyond the cited public contract?
Should any derived mission match be removed or narrowed before publication?
leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Official sources establish Canadian defence and technology prime with a seven-site national footprint spanning naval combat management, electronic warfare, all-domain systems integration, autonomous-system control software, advanced manufacturing, training, sustainment, and program delivery. The candidate should be reviewed as a broad prime-contractor portfolio with three distinct capability families, an evidenced flagship program, a public delivery relationship, and a Canadian operating footprint.
